mapper.select: select from mall_compensation_task where task_type=#{taskType} and business_key=#{businessKey}
mapper.update: update mall_compensation_task set status='PROCESSING',retry_count=retry_count+1,update_time=now() where task_id=#{taskId} and status in ('PENDING','FAILED') and retry_count < max_retries
update mall_compensation_task set status='SUCCESS',completed_time=now(),update_time=now() where task_id=#{taskId} and status='PROCESSING'
update mall_compensation_task set status=#{status},next_retry_time=#{nextRetryTime},last_error=#{lastError},update_time=now() where task_id=#{taskId} and status='PROCESSING'
update mall_compensation_task set status='PENDING',retry_count=0,next_retry_time=now(),last_error=null,completed_time=null,update_time=now() where task_id=#{taskId} and status in ('FAILED','MANUAL')

update mall_compensation_task set status=case when retry_count>=max_retries then 'MANUAL' else 'FAILED' end,next_retry_time=now(),last_error='执行进程中断，任务已自动恢复',update_time=now() where status='PROCESSING' and update_time <= #{cutoffTime}
